reply.text: I'm sorry your knee is bothering you. I can't tell you what's causing an ache or whether it's safe to train through, so that one's for a doctor or physio, not a coach. Once they've cleared you, tell me what they say to avoid, and I'll build the leg work around it. If you want, I can also swap the leg press in your program now for a different movement, so just say the word and which session it's in.
